versions.text: {{KW:MAGIC}}: {{KW:SWITCH}}: Choose a non-{{RARITY:TOKEN}} {{TRIBE:PIECE|1}} in your hand (except {{CARD:275|1}}) and {{SWITCH_LEFT:1|add a copy of it to your hand}} or {{SWITCH_RIGHT:1|2 to your deck}}.
